# DNS Test · 1ms.dog

> Free DNS speed test in the browser. Times 18 public DNS resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS, AdGuard DNS, NextDNS, Control D, Mullvad, DNS.SB, Hurricane Electric, Wikimedia DNS, AliDNS, DNSPod, 360 DNS, Yandex DNS, DNS4EU, CIRA Canadian Shield, IIJ Public DNS)
> from the visitor's own network: DNS over HTTPS measured for real on a warm connection (10 rounds, interleaved,
> median), UDP and DoT estimated by timing the same servers' addresses, plus uncached lookups and DNSSEC validation.
> Shows the fastest resolver and what to enter to use it. Nothing is sent to this site; queries go straight from the
> browser to each resolver.

- Page: https://dns.1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Direct rules for proxy tools (so the test measures your own network): https://dns.1ms.dog/rules/clash.yaml, surge.list, loon.list, quanx.list, singbox.json
- Source code and the resolver list: https://github.com/yt1988/dns-test

## Other 1ms.dog tools
- 1ms.dog: https://1ms.dog/ (Your exit IPs and latency to 40 services)
- EgressLens: https://egress.1ms.dog/ (Which IP each site sees: split routing, proxies, WebRTC and IPv6 leaks)
- IP Quality Test: https://ipqs.1ms.dog/ (How clean your IP is, from a dozen sources)
- Me2Cloud: https://m2c.1ms.dog/ (Latency to 360+ cloud regions)
- VPS2Cloud: https://v2c.1ms.dog/ (Latency from your server to the clouds)
- Lightsail Cost Saver: https://ls.1ms.dog/ (AWS Lightsail transfer calculator)
